landmarks.name: Statue of Liberty
landmarks.hint: Copper lady holding a torch, a gift from France in New York Harbor

landmarks.name: U.S. Capitol
landmarks.hint: Domed building where Congress meets, at the end of the National Mall

landmarks.name: Golden Gate Bridge
landmarks.hint: Orange-red suspension bridge spanning a foggy Pacific strait

landmarks.name: Grand Canyon
landmarks.hint: Mile-deep gorge carved by the Colorado River over millions of years

landmarks.name: Old Faithful
landmarks.hint: Geyser in the first national park that erupts like clockwork

landmarks.name: Mount Rushmore
landmarks.hint: Four presidents' faces carved into a granite mountainside in the Black Hills

landmarks.name: Cloud Gate
landmarks.hint: Mirrored steel sculpture nicknamed 'The Bean' in the Windy City

landmarks.name: French Quarter
landmarks.hint: Jazz-filled historic district with iron balconies and Mardi Gras parades

landmarks.name: Kennedy Space Center
landmarks.hint: Launch site of the Apollo Moon missions on Florida's Atlantic coast

landmarks.name: The Alamo
landmarks.hint: Old Spanish mission famous for an 1836 battle in Texas history

landmarks.name: Space Needle
landmarks.hint: Saucer-topped observation tower built for a 1962 World's Fair

landmarks.name: Hollywood Sign
landmarks.hint: Giant white letters on a hillside above the movie capital
